messages:
Elaine: quick Q — Product wants the Console SLO card to show multiple burn-rate windows (5m / 1h / 24h) AND a 'notify preview' that shows who would be paged given current notify policies + org quotas. Any objections to adding this to the SLO API? want to sketch UI behavior before design review.

Mike: sounds useful. main concern: computing a preview requires evaluating routing policies, suppression rules, per-tenant quotas and fallback tiers. I think it should be a separate opt-in endpoint so we don't regress runtime path perf.

Samir: +1. also we should surface a simple "noise score" (how often alerts like this fired historically) so users can tune thresholds. that ties into alert fingerprinting / similarity metrics.

Riya: question — should the preview run the full realtime routing logic (including dynamic backoffs and rate-limiting) or a deterministic simulation? deterministic seems clearer for UI (reproducible), but might not match eventual behavior exactly.

Mike: propose an explicit simulation API: POST /api/v1/slo/preview with payload fields (slo_id, window, simulated_capacity, tenant_quota_state, include_noise_score). It runs the routing decision engine in "read-only" mode and returns the effective contact set + reasons. Done async/worker to avoid blocking.

Elaine: can you paste a sample request/response shape so product can mock UI?

Mike: sure — example payload:

```
POST /api/v1/slo/preview
{
  "slo_id": "slo_1234",
  "window": "1h",
  "simulate": {
    "tenant_quota": {"monthly_alerts": 5000, "remaining": 120},
    "region": "us-west-2",
    "fallback_tier": "standard"
  },
  "include_noise_score": true
}
```

Samir: suggested response fields: preview_contacts: [ {channel: "pager", id: "t-***"}, ... ], noise_score: 0.72, estimated_token_cost: 12, throttle_applied: "soft-quota" or null, explanation: ["tenant quota remaining low", "region fallback applied"].

Riya: UX notes — show a prominent "SIMULATION" banner, include last-evaluated timestamp and confidence score. Also show a compact explanation for any throttle (e.g., "soft-quota fallback — email only").

Mike: security note — do NOT return raw user emails/phone numbers. Return role categories (pager/email/team-oncall) and obfuscated IDs. Also strip any PII from explanation strings.

Elaine: action items: Mike to draft the API + worker prototype, Samir to wire noise-ranking + fingerprint lookup, Riya to mock minimal UI copy and banner. We'll review in design sync next Tue. @deploy-bot please create a tracking issue.

deploy-bot: created issue RNF-4321 in eng-platform backlog — https://redwood/issues/RNF-4321 :white_check_mark:

Samir: perf addendum — cache preview results for ~60s keyed by (slo_id, window, tenant, simulate_params) to avoid thundering when product hits preview repeatedly. Also store a short audit log row for each preview for debugging (no PII).

Mike: agreed. also include estimated quota/cost in response so UI can warn customers they might exhaust monthly alert budget.

Elaine: perfect. no blockers from PM. moving to implement next sprint. :thumbsup:
